TooltipProvider.description: Groups the tooltips beneath it: once one has opened, moving to another trigger opens its tooltip at once and closes the first. Renders no element.

props.delay: How long the pointer rests on a trigger before its tooltip opens, in milliseconds. A trigger's own `delay` wins.
props.closeDelay: How long after the pointer leaves before a tooltip closes, in milliseconds. A trigger's own `closeDelay` wins.
props.timeout: How long after a tooltip closes another still opens at once when its trigger is hovered, in milliseconds.

TooltipRoot.description: Holds one tooltip's open state and shares it with its trigger and popup. Renders no element.

props.open: Whether the tooltip is open. Pass it with `onOpenChange` to control the tooltip.
props.defaultOpen: Whether the tooltip is open at first, when it isn't controlled.
props.onOpenChange: Called with the new state when hover, focus, a press, Escape or a press outside opens or closes the tooltip. It is called in a change of its own, after the tooltip's: a request it starts (text that loads on open), or a handler that is itself an action, doesn't hold the tooltip.
props.disabled: A disabled tooltip doesn't open, and closes if it was open.
props.disableHoverablePopup: Close the tooltip as soon as the pointer leaves the trigger, instead of letting it move onto the popup.

TooltipTrigger.description: The button the tooltip describes. It opens the tooltip on hover after a delay and on keyboard focus at once, and closes it on leave, blur and press. While the tooltip is open its `aria-describedby` points at the popup.

props.delay: How long the pointer rests on the trigger before the tooltip opens, in milliseconds. Falls back to the provider's, then to 600.
props.closeDelay: How long after the pointer leaves before the tooltip closes, in milliseconds. Falls back to the provider's, then to 0.
props.closeOnClick: Whether pressing the trigger closes the tooltip.

TooltipPopup.description: The popup: an element with `popover="manual"` and the `tooltip` role, placed against the trigger with CSS anchor positioning. Style it with `:popover-open` and `@starting-style`.

props.side: Which side of the trigger the popup sits on. The browser flips it when it doesn't fit.
props.align: Which edge of the trigger the popup lines up with, along the side.
props.sideOffset: The gap between the trigger and the popup, in pixels.
props.alignOffset: How far the popup is moved along the trigger's edge from its `align` position, in pixels.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the trigger the popup is on: the `side` asked for, then the side the browser placed it on once open.

TooltipArrow.description: An element placed on the popup's edge that faces the trigger, centred on the trigger. It follows the popup when the browser flips it. Give it a shape in CSS and turn it per `data-side`.

dataAttributes.data-side: Which side of the trigger the popup is on. Absent until the popup first opens; a close keeps the last side.
